use default

// C(n) = sum over i of C(i) * C(n - 1 - i)
by_convolution(n: int) -> long is
    if n == 0 then
        return 1L
    fi

    return (0..n)
        |> map(i => by_convolution(i) * by_convolution(n - 1 - i))
        |> reduce(0L, (running, term) => running + term)
si

// C(n) = 2 * (2n - 1) * C(n - 1) / (n + 1)
by_recurrence(n: int) -> long is
    let c mut = 1L

    for k in 1::n do
        c = 2L * (2L * cast long(k) - 1L) * c / (cast long(k) + 1L)
    od

    c
si

for n in 0::14 do
    write_line("{n,2}: {by_convolution(n),8} {by_recurrence(n),8}")
od
